Body.Content: Azure Managed Cache Service is a highly secured, dedicated cache that’s managed by Microsoft. It provides high performance and is easy to use in your cloud applications. A cache created using the Azure Cache Service is accessible from any application within Azure that’s running on Azure Web Sites, Cloud Services, or Virtual Machines. For more information, visit the Azure Cache page. To get a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the Cache Pricing Details page.
